conceptual_change: Introduce a price-action compression filter using rolling_std of range_ratio to identify potential breakout preparation in A-share stocks.
rationale: High-volatility regimes are often preceded by periods of compressed price range in A-share markets. By filtering for lower-than-average volatility using a rolling standard deviation of the range_ratio, we aim to isolate potential explosive moves while minimizing false signals from high-noise environments.
